metadata.title: Accept your invitation
metadata.description: Create your account from an invitation.

form.title: Join {appName}
form.description: You're invited as {role}. Choose your name and a password for {email}.
form.name: Name
form.hasAccount: Already have an account with this address? <link>Sign in</link> to accept the invitation.

claim.title: Accept your invitation
claim.description: You're signed in as {email}. Accept the invitation to join as {role}.

mismatch.title: This invitation is for another address
mismatch.description: It was sent to {invited}, and you're signed in as {current}. Sign out to accept it with that address.

invalid.title: This invitation link doesn't work
invalid.description: Open the link from the invitation email again, or ask the person who invited you for a new one.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Ask the person who invited you to send it again.

revoked.title: This invitation was withdrawn
revoked.description: Ask the person who invited you if you still need an account.

accepted.title: This invitation was already accepted
accepted.description: Sign in with the account it created.
